_comment: Carried over from 05293190AC (gaps filled through 05007038) by tools/port.py; do not edit by hand, edit the reference annotations and re-run.

EepromFlags.0: unresolved; no single-bit 01 access found in reviewed A/B banks
EepromFlags.1: readback-table work pending; EepromReadbackTableOffset is the table byte offset (EepromWriteService / EepromWriteQueue)
EepromFlags.2: bus message $91 write request, second kind (BusEepromWrite -> EepromWriteQueue)
EepromFlags.3: bus message $91 write request, first kind (BusEepromWrite -> EepromWriteQueue)
EepromFlags.4: second byte of a word write in progress (EepromWriteService)
EepromFlags.6: word write: two bytes to write (set with bit 7 by NvWriteRequest, SriMileageStore)
EepromFlags.7: EEPROM write requested: EepromData to EepromAddr (callers wait while it is set)

EquipmentFlags.0: copy of calibration bit $0330.4 at reset; not read
EquipmentFlags.1: copy of Options0321 bit 0 at reset
EquipmentFlags.2: power steering pressure switch fitted (calibration bit $0331.3, or EquipmentDetect)
EquipmentFlags.3: copy of calibration bit $032C.7 at reset
EquipmentFlags.4: automatic transmission, variant: set at reset instead of bit 5 when Options0321 bit 5 is set
EquipmentFlags.5: automatic transmission: set at reset unless Options0325 bit 5 (manual) or Options0321 bit 5

Options031D.0: hardware variant bit (HardwareCheck, GptRegisterCheck3, SparkEventCalc, StartInjectorPulse, KnockSample, QspiOutputStatus and others)
Options031D.1: hardware variant bit (HardwareCheck, GptRegisterCheck3, SparkEventCalc, StartInjectorPulse, IdleTargetControl, SpeedCtlControl and others)
Options031D.2: hardware variant bit (HardwareCheck, Isr_GPT_IC1, FinishFuelPulse, MisfireSegmentTime, QspiOutputStatus)
Options031D.3: hardware variant bit (HardwareCheck, GptRegisterCheck2, SparkEventCalc, FinishFuelPulse, RefPeriodUpdate, IdleTargetControl and others)
Options031D.4: hardware variant bit (HardwareCheck, GptRegisterCheck2, SparkEventCalc, FinishFuelPulse, RefPeriodUpdate, KnockSample)
Options031D.5: hardware set-up variant (Reset, HardwareCheck, GptRegisterCheck; also SparkEventCalc, FinishFuelPulse, KnockSample)
Options031D.6: hardware set-up variant (Reset, HardwareCheck, GptRegisterCheck; also SparkEventCalc, FinishFuelPulse, KnockSample)
Options031D.7: engine/ignition variant (HardwareCheck, SparkEventCalc, StartInjectorPulse, KnockSample, InjectorFuelAccount)

Options031E.2: A/C pressure sensor variant: idle A/C steps, clutch, cut and fan (AcClutchSpark, AcCutLogic, EquipmentDetect, IacLearn, IdleTargetControl)
Options031E.4: downstream O2 sensor 1 fitted (ClosedLoopManager, O2HeaterMonitor, O2UpdateDownstream)
Options031E.5: downstream O2 sensor 2 fitted (ClosedLoopManager, O2HeaterMonitor, O2DownResponseMonitor, O2UpdateDownstream)
Options031E.6: upstream O2 sensor 2 fitted, second bank (ClosedLoopManager, FuelSysTooRich2Monitor, FuelSysTooLean2Monitor, PurgeVaporLearn and others)
Options031E.7: upstream O2 sensor 1 fitted (ClosedLoopManager, FuelSysTooRich1Monitor, FuelSysTooLean1Monitor, O2HeaterMonitor, PurgeCellTrimFilter)

Options0321.0: copied to EquipmentFlags bit 1 at reset
Options0321.5: transmission variant: at reset an automatic gets EquipmentFlags bit 4 instead of bit 5 and transmission type 3 instead of 4; also GearStateUpdate, TccMonitor, SpeedCtlShift, IdleRpmTarget and others

Options0323.0: part-throttle fuel: MAP is held at the first x point of PartThrottleMapScale as a minimum (CalcFuelPulse)
Options0323.2: surge control on (SurgeControl); set in 05293013AC (manual), clear in 05293014AC
Options0323.5: closed loop off: the O2 control and learning are skipped (ClosedLoopMain, O2LearnEnable, O2UpdateUpstream, PurgeVaporLearn, FuelCorrections)
Options0323.6: spark/dwell variant (CalcSpark, DwellCalc, Isr_GPT_OC2, CalcEngineRpm, OcOutputsReset, Reset)
Options0323.7: per-event spark on (EventSparkControl, EventCorrections); also the cam signal handling (Isr_GPT_IC4OC5); set in 05293014AC (automatic)

Options0324.0: flex fuel on: ethanol content, flex factors and flex spark are used (FuelCorrections, FlexSensorCheck, FlexSparkCalc, O2FlexOffset and others)
Options0324.2: speed control switch variant; also used by EquipmentDetect
Options0324.6: selects a branch in GearStateUpdate; set in 05293014AC (automatic)

Options0325.2: alternative purge duty table (PurgeRampControl, with bit 3)
Options0325.3: alternative purge duty table (PurgeRampControl, with bit 2)
Options0325.5: manual transmission: the gear state, park/neutral and automatic-only paths are skipped (GearStateUpdate, PnSwitchMonitor, IdleRpmTarget and others); set in 05293013AC
Options0325.6: EGR monitor variant: EgrMonTest runs only with it, and EgrFlowReport, EgrSparkCalc and FuelCorrections add EGR fault checks (EgrFlowMonitor and others); clear in 05293013AC/14AC. In reviewed 05293013AC, ObdRequest has no direct Options0325 bit 6 entry gate

Options0326.7: idle flare check off (IdleFlareCheck skips when set)

Options032D.4: closed-loop temperature (coolant warm-up) monitor on (CoolantWarmupMonitor, P0125)
Options032D.5: brake switch, VSS and purge flow monitors variant
Options032D.6: park/neutral switch monitor on (PnSwitchMonitor, PnSwitchMonitor2); set in 05293014AC (automatic)
